name: laxmi-fashion-store
description: Laxmi Fashion Wholesale Mart — local-first store management (PWA + Windows desktop + Android)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @laxmi/server" "npm run dev -w @laxmi/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @laxmi/web && npm run build -w @laxmi/server
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:desktop-runtime && npm run dist:win -w @laxmi/desktop && node scripts/copy-win-artifact.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build -w @laxmi/web && npx cap sync android
